findings.title: Update on Cybersecurity Event at UNM Health Sciences Center
findings.publisher: University of New Mexico Health Sciences Center
findings.exact_supporting_passage: All UNM Health hospitals (UNM Hospital and SRMC) are open, and all clinics will resume regularly scheduled appointments and procedures Tuesday, Oct. 27, 2026.
findings.service_line: Hospital operations at UNM Hospital and Sandoval Regional Medical Center; planned resumption of outpatient appointments and procedures
findings.access_consequences: In its 10:27 p.m. MDT October 26 update (9:27 p.m. PDT, within this watch window), UNM Health confirmed both hospitals are open following the earlier cybersecurity-related interruption. It also stated clinics will resume regularly scheduled appointments and procedures Tuesday, October 27. Tuesday clinic resumption is a future commitment, not yet independently observed. The update does not explicitly confirm that ambulance diversion ended or that Level 1 trauma/ED intake was fully restored.
findings.affected_population: Hospital patients in Albuquerque and Rio Rancho, New Mexico; clinic patients throughout UNM Health, including people with previously canceled appointments. Exact number affected is unknown.
